## Design

### 2026-10-11: Before tracking the time I took making the first connections of my flight controller I took about an hour for research, I've always been into FPV drones and such but I've never really built anything m

**2.93h**

Before tracking the time I took making the first connections of my flight controller I took about an hour for research, I've always been into FPV drones and such but I've never really built anything myself because I thought it was very costly hobby, looks like it doesnt have to be that costly, I researched by firstly searching up all the components I need for a drone, I used Claude at first and then later on after having an idea of where to go I started skimming through datasheets of all the parts I needed and then I used Gemini all the way through for any quick insights on parts and connections, it's my first ever time trying to make a PCB so I got quite a lot of stuff wrong most probably, I'll probably fix whatever mess I created tommorow but other than that I found a guy making a flight controller who's videos I watched to get a bit more idea of what iam dealing with here, here's the link to the YouTube video(technically a 6 video series):

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Rv1MVkZuGbg&list=PLoPtpxJIxgnYnPrOeGHs3rdhhPgNGIYN5

7 year old video but I think I still did manage to learn a little something about what to avoid and what I should do.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/TfgGlSVHCZQMzFmVQLHAMKiKD2tjjzgX/fb9bb11cd406018c666a58645907b0e87e4227e150497982ec65684d5d2c559f.png)

So far I've only made a USB-C to UART circuit that will let me communicate with the ESP32-WROOM-32E that I plan on using instead of buying a module, that way I'd have some experience working with bare SMD microcontroller chips.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/TfgGlSVHCZQMzFmVQLHAMKiKD2tjjzgX/ab9d4423beb2ee785c2001bcb9654cd40416bbd732b65e9288242046948cdc30.png)

### 2026-11-02: I thought about Making a order on JLCPBA because I dont really have micro soldering tools but I didn't really have CPL files and BOM files that matched with JLCPB'S standards and they also had some fo

**4h**

I thought about Making a order on JLCPBA because I dont really have micro soldering tools but I didn't really have CPL files and BOM files that matched with JLCPB'S standards and they also had some formatting issues which I had to fix by hand so that took me a decent amount of time to fix when I first started this project, Couldn't journal it but now I can since I got a extension.

the one on the left notepad is the EasyEDA export and the one on the right is what I had to fix by hand.
![bom mismatch](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/TfgGlSVHCZQMzFmVQLHAMKiKD2tjjzgX/229a1c1163e794fdf86c3454e3d3df08a6eca0ebf7e03b3602e0a0f701064438.png)

Basically gave antigravity the examples, showed him all the parts their id, names, companies and etc. and told it to work and make me some files
![Bom and pickandplace](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/TfgGlSVHCZQMzFmVQLHAMKiKD2tjjzgX/8710180b631dd9cd17abbfa5bc7663ec1a281055ee4f8f457dc28fea9d52a901.png)

it was kind of a tedious task so I used the help of Gemini flash agents in antigravity to do all the tedious things like formatting it in certain ways I also made Gemini make my readmes since it could read my schematic and PCB really well, it also gave some disclaimers for ground wires iam pretty sure it wouldn't be that big of a deal considering this is my first board and basically just a proof of concept.

![readme](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/TfgGlSVHCZQMzFmVQLHAMKiKD2tjjzgX/07a620d09d4c2090548e7efb857a0dbdde8ced6d4828fceb54da54a45e775b43.png)

 EasyEDA also wouldn't export a BOM that I could directly upload and have a platform detect so that was a bit of a pain too, in the end unfortunately as much as I hate to admit it, a good portion of my code was made by Gemini because I didn't really have the time to manually hand code everything, in the rush to submit it I accidently submitted it's own scripts.

![Code](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/TfgGlSVHCZQMzFmVQLHAMKiKD2tjjzgX/4168fe6c3a654f9cb5d1d73a1ccc46b2f2b219597e88959f00795aff083c51c2.png)
